protocol_repair: The original frozen registration is preserved in git history. Before any seed-2104 or seed-2105 checkpoint was loaded for this audit, independent static review found that cumulative beta_H or beta_delta equivalence could hide cancellation among earlier atomic elasticities, and that final constant calibration could coexist with internal co-adaptation. This repair makes the four atomic terms symmetric and reports final-comparator and layer-ledger decisions on separate axes. No estimand values, checkpoints, Liu outputs, or audit results were inspected before this repair.
scientific_question: Which frozen functional layer best matches the excessive scale of the global policy potential: additive fast-weight drive, recurrent nonlinear expression, frozen state-readout alignment, or mixing with the P-independent query baseline?
current_theory: Differential evidence access into P_T and L_T is the frozen working learning mechanism. The remaining nonlearned distance-slope discrepancy is already localized to an over-sharp additive global policy potential, while normalized geometry, Hodge residual, and the fixed sigmoid are not amplifying sources.
diagnostic_hypothesis: A same-coordinate, P-off-subtracted amplitude ledger can localize the subjectwise posterior-relative calibration fingerprint to the earliest cumulative layer whose log-elasticity departs from the posterior-equivalent policy amplitude.
claim_boundary: This is a two-frozen-backbone amplitude-provenance audit, not causal source identification. It can report exact functional bookkeeping and replicated layer fingerprints in the frozen coordinates. It cannot uniquely assign scale to P_T versus W_out under hidden-state reparameterization, infer W_out-norm effects from two networks, establish network-population prevalence, identify biological stores, fit a temperature, or authorize a model intervention.
registration_timing: Frozen after the fresh-backbone v2.4 confirmation and global-policy slope localization, before writing this diagnostic runner or replaying either checkpoint for this audit.

network_contract.checkpoint_selection: Use exactly the jointly hash-locked final checkpoints from the fresh v2.4 confirmation.
network_contract.primary_condition: Pure L-off global replay with intact terminal P_T and frozen W_out.
network_contract.P_off_control: For the same trained support state, cues, subjects, and queries, replace P_T by an exact all-zero tensor only during query replay. Do not use WRITE_OFF, RESET, or alpha-zero.
network_contract.participant_inference: Bootstrap all 77 participants separately within each network. Never pool rows across networks.

runtime_contract.all_seed_execution: Both networks must complete in one command before the result is written.

query_field_contract.edges: All 28 lexicographic unordered pairs and both orientations, for 56 frozen query trials per participant.
query_field_contract.h0: The hidden state after query step 0. Because the preceding hidden state is zero, h0=tanh(i2h(x0)) and is invariant to P_T.
query_field_contract.first_fast_weight_sensitive_drive: u_q=(alpha elementwise-multiplied by P_T)h0_q at response step 1.
query_field_contract.P_induced_hidden: delta_h_q=tanh(b_q+u_q)-tanh(b_q), verified against intact-minus-P-off response hidden.
query_field_contract.antisymmetric_fields: For each canonical edge, take one half of forward minus reverse orientation for u, intact response hidden, P-off response hidden, delta_h, and logit margin.
query_field_contract.vector_hodge: With complete-graph incidence B and score operator B_plus=pinv(B), item-vector potentials use U=B_plus U_edge and V=B_plus H_edge. B_plus fixes the minimum-norm zero-sum gauge.
query_field_contract.output_direction: w=W_out[1]-W_out[0]. Output bias must cancel under orientation antisymmetrization.
query_field_contract.P_induced_boundary: Intact-minus-P-off is a finite-amplitude functional contrast including baseline-dependent tanh interaction, not an independent linear state or biological store.

amplitude_ledger.functional_additive_drive: a_P=||B_plus antisym(u)||_F. This excludes query-common and nonadditive drive and is not ||P_T|| or ||alpha elementwise-multiplied by P_T||.
amplitude_ledger.raw_oriented_drive_secondary: Report sqrt(mean over 56 oriented queries of ||u_q||_2^2) as a nonprimary total-drive diagnostic.
amplitude_ledger.projection_gain: g_out=a_delta/a_H=||w||_2 rho_W, where rho_W=a_delta/(a_H||w||_2). Within one network, variation in g_out is variation in alignment rho_W, not W_out norm.
amplitude_ledger.baseline_mixing_gain: g_mix=a_N/a_delta. It is amplitude bookkeeping for P-independent baseline mixing, not a linear causal gain.
amplitude_ledger.directional_P_contribution: phi_P=<s_intact,s_P>/||s_intact||_2^2 and phi_0=<s_intact,s_Poff>/||s_intact||_2^2, so phi_P+phi_0=1. These signed squared-amplitude allocations are not probabilities.
amplitude_ledger.zero_denominator_rule: Use no epsilon. If any required amplitude is <=1e-12, retain the participant's amplitudes but mark all gain, log, and provenance decisions for that network non-interpretable.

posterior_comparator.hypothesis_log_weights: ell_pi=-E(pi)/0.05 from the exact frozen posterior and each participant's realized stable-omission evidence.
posterior_comparator.same_unit_margin: m_post,ij=0.25[logsumexp(ell_pi for pi with i above j)-logsumexp(ell_pi for pi with j above i)].
posterior_comparator.same_unit_identity: sigmoid(m_post,ij/0.25)=P_post(i above j), with no probability clipping.
posterior_comparator.same_unit_potential: s_post=B_plus m_post and a_post=||s_post||_2, in the same policy-margin units as s_intact.
posterior_comparator.primary_mismatch: Y=log(a_N)-log(a_post). The raw neural/expected-rank norm ratio is forbidden because its units are arbitrary.
posterior_comparator.probability_space_validation: F_N=2 sigmoid(m_N/0.25)-1 and F_post=2P_post-1; report d_prob=||B_plus F_N||_2-||B_plus F_post||_2. It is a mandatory direction check and cannot replace the primary comparator.
posterior_comparator.shape_model: Within each network fit the through-origin cohort scalar c=sum_s <s_post,s_intact>/sum_s ||s_post||_2^2 and report 1-sum_s||s_intact-c s_post||_2^2/sum_s||s_intact||_2^2, normalized cosine, and residual energy.
posterior_comparator.expected_rank_secondary: Report normalized posterior entropy and normalized expected-rank commitment only as external descriptors, never as a denominator for neural policy amplitude.

external_variables.coverage: C=(1/8)sum_r z_sr, the fraction of the eight unique support relations admitted to the global path. This is the only coverage definition.
external_variables.forbidden_coverage_alternatives: No magnitude weighting, latent p_sr, trial-count variant, graph connectivity, or post-hoc selection.
external_variables.posterior_certainty: Q=1-H[q(pi|D_s)]/log(8!), with U=1-Q reported as normalized entropy.
external_variables.inference_boundary: C and Q are related consequences of the same evidence. Analyze them in separate one-predictor models, report their correlation, and never claim independent explained variance.

statistical_estimands.posterior_axis: Let Z=log(a_post). Separately regress log(a_P), log(a_H), log(a_delta), and log(a_N) on Z within participant rows.
statistical_estimands.cumulative_elasticities: Call the four slopes beta_P, beta_H, beta_delta, and beta_N.
statistical_estimands.external_tracking: Separately regress Y and each log cumulative amplitude on raw C and raw Q. Report Pearson correlations and OLS slopes; do not choose between Pearson and Spearman and do not fit C and Q jointly.
statistical_estimands.part_whole_prohibition: Do not regress Y, a_N/a_post, or the Track-B mismatch on their own multiplicative factors and do not call a largest raw correlation a source.
statistical_estimands.Track_B_premise: Reproduce every participant's frozen beta_p-minus-beta_posterior and a_N from the Track-B result before interpreting provenance.

bootstrap.rule: Recompute all means, scalar fits, correlations, OLS slopes, elasticities, increments, and contrasts from each resampled set of participant rows. All 10000 estimates must be finite; never discard an undefined resample. Any undefined estimate makes that network non-interpretable.

statistical_estimands.directional_rule: A positive or negative claim requires the registered 95% participant-bootstrap interval to exclude zero in that direction.
statistical_estimands.elasticity_materiality: For beta-1 or any delta, material positive requires lower95>0.10 and material negative requires upper95<-0.10.
statistical_estimands.elasticity_equivalence: Equivalence to the registered target requires the entire 90% interval for beta-1 or delta to lie within [-0.10,+0.10]. An interval merely containing zero is unresolved.
statistical_estimands.external_equivalence: A Y-on-C or Y-on-Q slope is equivalent to zero only when its entire 90% interval lies within [-log(1.10),+log(1.10)], corresponding to less than 10 percent amplitude-mismatch change over the full [0,1] predictor range.
statistical_estimands.network_replication: Every branch must satisfy its rules independently in both 2104 and 2105; participant rows and bootstrap samples are never pooled.

outcome_tree.noninterpretable_integrity_failure: Any source, artifact, runtime, parameter-immutability, subject-count, reconstruction, denominator, or exact-identity gate fails.
outcome_tree.premise_not_reproduced: The Track-B probability-slope mismatch mean lower95 is not positive in either network.
outcome_tree.comparator_sensitive_unresolved: Y and d_prob do not both have positive lower95 bounds in both networks. Preserve Track B but stop amplitude provenance and do not intervene.
outcome_tree.atomic_layer_terms: Use e_P=beta_P-1, e_rec=delta_rec, e_out=delta_out, and e_mix=delta_mix. A unique layer requires its own term to be replicated material in the same direction and all other three atomic terms to be equivalent to zero in both networks.
outcome_tree.constant_calibration_fingerprint: Final-comparator axis only. In both networks: c lower95>1; scalar shape-energy explained lower95>=0.90; beta_N-1 is equivalent to zero; Y-on-C and Y-on-Q are equivalent to zero; and the probability-space direction check passes. This flag does not suppress or replace the layer-elasticity decision.
outcome_tree.functional_drive_fingerprint: Layer axis. In both networks: e_P is material in the same direction; e_rec, e_out, and e_mix are each equivalent to zero.
outcome_tree.recurrent_expression_fingerprint: Layer axis. In both networks: e_rec is material in the same direction; e_P, e_out, and e_mix are each equivalent to zero.
outcome_tree.projection_alignment_fingerprint: Layer axis. In both networks: e_out is material in the same direction; e_P, e_rec, and e_mix are each equivalent to zero. This is alignment/projection efficiency, not W_out-norm identification.
outcome_tree.P_independent_mixing_fingerprint: Layer axis. In both networks: e_mix is material in the same direction; e_P, e_rec, and e_out are each equivalent to zero; phi and cross-term summaries must be reported.
outcome_tree.coadapted_scale_fingerprint: Layer axis. Two or more of e_P, e_rec, e_out, and e_mix are independently replicated material, including material terms of opposite signs that cancel in beta_N-1.
outcome_tree.heterogeneous_or_unresolved: The two networks select different branches, no directional/equivalence rule closes, or the scalar shape model leaves more than 10 percent energy unexplained.
outcome_tree.decision_axes: After integrity, Track-B premise, comparator-direction, and scalar-shape gates, report final_comparator_fingerprint and layer_elasticity_fingerprint separately. The former may be constant_calibration_fingerprint while the latter is unique, coadapted, or unresolved.
outcome_tree.decision_priority: Apply integrity, Track-B premise, comparator-direction, and scalar-shape gates first. Then compute the final-comparator flag and the symmetric four-term layer flag independently. Do not choose the numerically largest effect post hoc.

integrity_gates.formal_runtime: visible GPU, one PyTorch intra-op thread, and one inter-op thread
integrity_gates.complete_execution: both networks, all 77 participants, 28 edges, and 56 orientations
integrity_gates.response_transition: intact preactivation minus P-off preactivation must equal u; tanh difference must equal intact-minus-P-off response hidden
integrity_gates.hidden_to_logit: m=H w and output bias cancels after antisymmetrization
integrity_gates.Hodge: zero-sum gauge, projection residual orthogonality, and Hodge/readout commutation must pass
integrity_gates.P_off_subtraction: V_intact=V_Poff+V_P and s_intact=s_Poff+s_P; the squared-norm cross-term identity must pass
integrity_gates.amplitude: a_N=a_P g_rec g_out g_mix and g_out=||w|| rho_W; 0<=rho_W<=1
integrity_gates.posterior: logsumexp orientation reversal, sigmoid inverse-link, exact probability field, entropy range, and expected-rank Hodge identity must pass
integrity_gates.statistics: all cumulative/incremental slope identities and direct-versus-derived mismatch slopes must pass
integrity_gates.no_filtering_or_posthoc_repair: No participant, edge, relation, network, predictor, comparator, or result may be removed, replaced, added, or redefined after execution.

stop_go.current_audit: Read-only only. No scale intervention is authorized by this contract.
stop_go.constant_calibration: Only after replicated constant_calibration_fingerprint may a separate generic-only scalar-calibration sufficiency test be registered; Liu temperature fitting remains forbidden.
stop_go.unique_layer: Only after a replicated unique layer fingerprint may a matched, separately frozen intervention target that functional layer.
stop_go.coadapted: Require a separately frozen matched factorial intervention; do not select one component by effect size.
stop_go.unresolved: Stop scale correction and do not add post-hoc variables. Preserve the cohort-wide or network-level units-calibration possibility as unresolved.
